caption: The drawing depicts a single silver spoon centered vertically and horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The spoon is seen from above, showing its oval-shaped bowl and elongated handle. The bowl has subtle shading to indicate its reflective metallic surface, with highlights and darker areas to suggest depth and curvature. The handle is narrow and widens slightly towards the end, with detailed, fine-lined patterns along its length, especially near the tip. There is a decorative monogram or script insignia engraved at the terminal of the handle. The overall color palette consists of shades of gray for the spoon and an even, light beige for the paper, with no additional objects or colors present in the composition.
title: Silver Soup Spoon
